class.name: LocalPlayer
class.brief_description: A player on this device: player 1 or a guest.
class.description: One of [member LocalPlayers.players]. Player 1 is the signed-in player. A plain guest has no saves of their own. A local profile is a guest remembered on this device, with saves of their own kept like player 1's, and no account. A guest who brought their profile with their email (and maybe asked this device to remember them) has their own account and saves, which this device can only load and save. A player's own saves are [member saves]; player 1's are also [Saves].

method.name: confirm_email
method.description: For a local profile, after [method link_email]: checks the code and turns the profile into a remembered guest with that account, its saves going up to it. Await it for the result.

method.name: forget
method.description: Forgets a remembered guest or a local profile on this device. A local profile lives only here, so its progress is deleted; a remembered guest's account and saves are untouched.

method.name: get_achievements
method.description: Returns this player's achievements as [code]{id: progress}[/code], progress from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code]. Player 1's are [method Achievements.get_all].

method.name: link_email
method.description: For a local profile: emails a code to the person's address so they can keep their progress on their own account, to enter for [method confirm_email]. Player 1 uses [method Account.link_email]. Await it for the result.

method.name: needs_display_name
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the game should ask this player for a name: player 1 without a platform name (see [method Account.needs_display_name]), or a plain guest the game hasn't named yet (they're called "Guest" until then). A local profile already has its name, and a guest who brought their profile has their account's.

method.name: remember
method.description: Remembers a plain guest on this device as a local profile named [param name], with progress of their own kept like player 1's (in the platform's cloud, or on this device). Await it for the result.

method.name: set_achievement_progress
method.description: Records this player's progress towards an achievement, unlocked at [param total]: player 1's as [method Achievements.set_progress]; a guest's kept on their account, like [method unlock_achievement].

method.name: set_display_name
method.description: Names this player (1 to 24 characters). For player 1 it's [method Account.set_display_name]. A plain guest's name lasts while they play; a local profile's is kept with it on this device. A guest who brought their profile can't be renamed here ([code]error[/code] [code]"own_device"[/code]): they change their name on their own device. Await it for the result.

method.name: unlock_achievement
method.description: Unlocks an achievement for this player: on the platform for player 1; for a guest, kept on their account and unlocked on their own platform the next time they play on their own device.

members.member: The player's account on the online service. Without it (or before this device has reached it), their ID on the platform they're signed in with, or empty where there's none.
What kind of player this is.
Whether this device remembers the player.
The player's own saves, or [code]null[/code] for a plain guest, whose progress the game keeps in player 1's.

constants.constant: A plain guest, without saves of their own.
A guest remembered on this device, with saves of their own and no account.
A guest who brought their own profile with their email, with their own account and saves.
